title: Keeping Up With Science #1: AI in Everyday Life

teacherNotes.title: Session Goal
teacherNotes.content: Engage participants in discussing how generative AI, machine learning algorithms, and automation impact daily habits, jobs, and decision-making.

elements.content: Discuss the following rapid-fire questions with your group (1 min each):

1. What AI tool (e.g. ChatGPT, recommendation engines, voice assistants) do you use most frequently?
2. Have you ever followed a recommendation made by an algorithm that surprised you?
3. Would you trust an AI doctor to diagnose a medical symptom?

slides.title: Useful Phrasebank: Expressing Opinions on Tech

elements.content: Practice incorporating these phrases into your discussion:

• 'From a technological standpoint...'
• 'It’s a double-edged sword because...'
• 'We need to strike a balance between innovation and privacy.'
• 'There’s no denying that...'
In pairs or small breakout rooms, analyze the following statement:
'AI will create more high-value creative jobs than it destroys in repetitive manual sectors.'

elements.placeholder: Write key takeaways or new vocabulary learned from your partner...

elements.content: Debate Scenario: Should governments strictly regulate AI development even if it slows down scientific innovation?
Which concern do you think poses the greatest risk in AI adoption?
